lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: sir sabhanaa samarath nadar nihaaliaa ||17||
lines.translation: You are the Almighty Overlord of all; You bless us with Your Glance of Grace. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh mad lobh moh dusat baasanaa nivaar ||
lines.translation: Take away my sexual desire, anger, pride, greed, emotional attachment and evil desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raakh lehu prabh aapane naanak sad balihaar ||1||
lines.translation: Protect me, O my God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਘਠਾ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaa(n)diaa khaa(n)diaa muhu ghathaa paina(n)diaa sabh a(n)g ||
lines.translation: By eating and eating, the mouth is worn out; by wearing clothes, the limbs grow weary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dhrig tinaa daa jeeviaa jin sach na lago ra(n)g ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, cursed are the lives of those who are not attuned to the Love of the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਹੋਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu teraa hukam tivai tiu hovanaa ||
lines.translation: As is the Hukam of Your Command, so do things happen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਰਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ਖੜੋਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah rakhahi aap tah jaai khaRovanaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever You keep me, there I go and stand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੋਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam terai kai ra(n)g duramat dhovanaa ||
lines.translation: With the Love of Your Name, I wash away my evil-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap jap tudh nira(n)kaar bharam bhau khovanaa ||
lines.translation: By continually meditating on You, O Formless Lord, my doubts and fears are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo terai ra(n)g rate se jon na jovanaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to Your Love, shall not be trapped in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ik nain alovanaa ||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, they behold the One Lord with their eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰੋਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee pachhaataa hukam tinh kade na rovanaa ||
lines.translation: Those who recognize the Lord's Command never weep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਰੋਵਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naau naanak bakhasees man maahi parovanaa ||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are blessed with the gift of the Name, woven into the fabric of their minds. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੁਆ ਰਲੰਦੜੋ ਖਾਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevadiaa na chetio muaa rala(n)daRo khaak ||
lines.translation: Those who do not remember the Lord while they are alive, shall mix with the dust when they die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਿਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਪਾਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak duneeaa sa(n)g gudaariaa saakat mooR napaak ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the foolish and filthy faithless cynic passes his life engrossed in the world. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਮਰੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeva(n)diaa har chetiaa mara(n)diaa har ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: One who remembers the Lord while he is alive, shall be imbued with the Lord's Love when he dies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath taariaa naanak saadhoo sa(n)g ||2||
lines.translation: The precious gift of his life is redeemed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaadee aap rakhan vaaliaa ||
lines.translation: From the beginning, and through the ages, You have been our Protector and Preserver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam karataar sach pasaariaa ||
lines.translation: True is Your Name, O Creator Lord, and True is Your Creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਣਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: oonaa kahee na hoi ghate ghat saariaa ||
lines.translation: You do not lack anything; You are filling each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: miharavaan samarath aape hee ghaaliaa ||
lines.translation: You are merciful and all-powerful; You Yourself cause us to serve You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh man vuthaa aap se sadaa sukhaaliaa ||
lines.translation: Those whose minds in which You dwell are forever at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape rachan rachaai aape hee paaliaa ||
lines.translation: Having created the creation, You Yourself cherish it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap bea(n)t apaariaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are everything, O infinite, endless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore kee tek naanak sa(n)mhaaliaa ||19||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Protection and Support of the Perfect Guru. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad madh ar a(n)t paramesar rakhiaa ||
lines.translation: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, the Transcendent Lord has saved me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur ditaa har naam a(n)mrit chakhiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with the Lord's Name, and I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhaa sa(n)g apaar anadin har gun ravai ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਭਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paae manorath sabh jonee nah bhavai ||
lines.translation: I have obtained all my objectives, and I shall not wander in reincarnation again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh karate hath kaaran jo karai ||
lines.translation: Everything is in the Hands of the Creator; He does what is done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan sa(n)taa dhoor tarai ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Holy, which shall deliver him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis no ma(n)n vasaai jin upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Enshrine Him in your mind, the One who created you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jan dhiaaiaa khasam tin sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever meditates on the Lord and Master obtains peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal janam paravaan guramukh aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is the birth, and approved is the coming of the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamai bujh nihaal khasam phuramaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command shall be blessed - so has the Lord and Master ordained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਹ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis hoaa aap kripaal s nah bharamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy does not wander.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਸਮਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo ditaa khasam soee sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord and Master gives him, with that he is content.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਿਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jisahi daiaal bujhaae hukam mit ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the kindness of the Lord, our Friend, realizes the Hukam of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi bhulaae aap mar mar jamahi nit ||2||
lines.translation: But those whom the Lord Himself causes to wander, continue to die, and take reincarnation again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਤਕਾਲਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਣ ਨ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak maare tatakaal khin tikan na dite ||
lines.translation: The slanderers are destroyed in an instant; they are not spared for even a moment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਖਵਿ ਸਕਹਿ ਫੜਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh daas kaa dukh na khav sakahi phaR jonee jute ||
lines.translation: God will not endure the sufferings of His slaves, but catching the slanderers, He binds them to the cycle of reincarnation.
